root_cause: Ripley navigation capture discovers the entire site-wide mega-menu (menucomponent/api/menu?displayable_only=true) covering 1258 nodes across 21 non-fashion departments (automotive, electronics, hardware, supermarket, sports, etc.) plus 220 competitor brand showcases. In autonomous_pipeline.py, parse_navigation_source and _nav_records inserted all 1258 nodes indiscriminately into the audit category queue without filtering non-commercial structural containers or brand navigation. When the operational batch limit (max_batches) halted scraping after 10 batches, all 1259 remaining nodes were tagged with stop_reason='NOT_VISITED' and counted as pending frontier (frontier_remaining=1259), falsely presenting global department store navigation as unverified commercial categories of brand Nicopoly.
